firm_data.firm_description: Harris Beach Murtha Cullina PLLC is a full-service law firm providing legal and professional services to clients across New York state, as well as nationally and internationally. The firm has grown to 250 attorneys across 17 locations.
notable_facts: The firm was formed through the combination of Harris Beach PLLC and Murtha Cullina LLP.
Harris Beach is ranked as a BTI Elite law firm based on interviews of corporate counsel.

ai_contact.name: Brendan M. Palfreyman
ai_contact.ai_notes: The firm launched an Artificial Intelligence Industry Team to assist clients with navigating the legal, ethical, regulatory and business challenges raised by AI. The team is comprised of more than a dozen attorneys and is led by Brendan M. Palfreyman, Timothy J. Plunkett, and Alan M. Winchester.
